name: Twitch Gamers
description: A social graph of Twitch users with about 168k nodes, built from mutual friendships; the Twitch collection includes regional datasets such as Deezer Europe and Genius inline. This record describes metadata only; no data is vendored.
citation: Rozemberczki, B., Sarkar, R., & Sutton, C. (2021). Twitch Gamers: A Dataset for Evaluating Graph Learning Algorithms. https://snap.stanford.edu/data/twitch_gamers.html
